infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TruFit uses your location to discover nearby sports turfs, arenas, and calculate driving distance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: TruFit uses your location to find nearby sports turfs and arenas.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TruFit uses your camera to let you take and upload photos for turf listings, reviews, and user profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TruFit accesses your photo library so you can upload turf gallery pictures and profile avatars.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow TruFit to use your location to find nearby sports turfs and calculate distances.

plugins.photosPermission: TruFit needs access to your photos to upload turf and profile pictures.
